description: This file is a Java interface for the ConceptService in the OpenMRS core API. It defines methods for managing concepts and related entities such as drugs, concept classes, concept sources, concept proposals, concept map types, concept reference terms, and more. The interface includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, retiring, purging, and searching concepts and associated data. It also manages concepts' mappings to external terminologies, concept indexes, stop words, and other concept-related metadata.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTerm
classes.description: Represents a reference term associated with a concept source, including attributes like code, name, and retired status.

classes.name: ConceptSource
classes.description: Represents a source or coding system for concepts, used for mapping and referencing concepts externally.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTermMap
classes.description: Represents a mapping relationship between concept reference terms, often indicating equivalence or relatedness.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceRange
classes.description: Contains reference range data for a concept, such as normal value ranges for numeric concepts.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermByName
methods.description: Retrieves a concept reference term by name from a specific concept source, case insensitive, throws APIException.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a concept reference term by code from a specific concept source, throws APIException.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermByCode (with includeRetired)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of concept reference terms by code, with option to include retired terms, throws APIException.

methods.name: saveConceptReferenceTerm
methods.description: Creates or updates a concept reference term in the database, throws APIException.

methods.name: retireConceptReferenceTerm
methods.description: Retires the specified concept reference term with a provided reason, throws APIException.

methods.name: unretireConceptReferenceTerm
methods.description: Unretires a previously retired concept reference term, drops retire reason fields, throws APIException.

methods.name: purgeConceptReferenceTerm
methods.description: Completely removes a concept reference term from the database, fails if in use, throws APIException.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTerms
methods.description: Searches for concept reference terms matching query, from given source, supports pagination and retired filtering.

methods.name: getCountOfConceptReferenceTerms
methods.description: Counts the number of concept reference terms matching query, source, and retired inclusion.

methods.name: getReferenceTermMappingsTo
methods.description: Fetches all mappings where given term is termB, returns list of ConceptReferenceTermMap.

methods.name: getConceptsByName
methods.description: Returns concepts matching a name in given locale, case insensitive, includes only non-voided names.

methods.name: getDefaultConceptMapType
methods.description: Returns the default concept map type as set by global properties.

methods.name: isConceptNameDuplicate
methods.description: Checks if a concept name is a duplicate based on case, voided status, locale, and concept.

methods.name: getDrugs
methods.description: Retrieves non-retired drugs matching search phrases, concept names, or reference term codes, considering locales.

methods.name: getDrugsByMapping
methods.description: Gets drugs linked via concept mappings to specified concept source, code, and map types.

methods.name: getDrugByMapping
methods.description: Returns the best-matching drug for the given code, source, and map type preferences.

methods.name: getOrderableConcepts
methods.description: Finds orderable concepts matching phrase, locales, and retirement status, for specified pagination.

methods.name: getAllConceptAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all concept attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: saveConceptAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a concept attribute type.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches a concept attribute type by internal ID.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a concept attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: purgeConceptAttributeType
methods.description: Removes a concept attribute type from the database, permanently.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves concept attribute types matching name pattern, including retired.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches a concept attribute type by exact name.

methods.name: retireConceptAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a concept attribute type with a reason.

methods.name: unretireConceptAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a concept attribute type.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a concept attribute by UUID.

methods.name: hasAnyConceptAttribute
methods.description: Checks if any concept has attributes of a given type.

methods.name: saveConceptReferenceRange
methods.description: Creates or updates a ConceptReferenceRange.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRangesByConceptId
methods.description: Fetches reference ranges for a specific concept ID.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRangeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a reference range by UUID.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRange
methods.description: Gets a reference range contextually for person and concept.

methods.name: purgeConceptReferenceRange
methods.description: Permanently deletes a ConceptReferenceRange.
